assumptions: Block sums are independent across blocks and symmetric about zero under the null boundary theta = 0; heavy skew or dependence across 4-day blocks violates this.
Calibration is at the null boundary theta = 0; strictly negative means are expected to be more conservative but are not simulated.
Only a 28-day fold is covered; other lengths need new calibration.

calibration_rules.fail: FAIL if any null scenario FWER Wilson lower bound exceeds .075, or power scenario any-rejection Wilson upper bound is below .30.
calibration_rules.inconclusive: Anything else (including a FWER upper bound above .075 without a lower bound above it, low power, or refusals > 5%).
calibration_rules.interpretation: A PASS is a synthetic size/power result for this exact v2 candidate on the declared generators only. It validates no market assumption and supports no efficacy claim. Power is for the declared alternative only.
calibration_rules.intervals: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for each null scenario's any-rejection rate (FWER) and for power; marginal per-cell rates reported as diagnostics.
calibration_rules.pass: PASS only if every null scenario has FWER Wilson upper bound <= .075, power Wilson lower bound >= .50, and every scenario has refusal rate <= 5%, and no runtime failure.
calibration_rules.runs: Exactly one run: 2000 independent panels for each of 7 scenarios, seeded per scenario from the frozen seed. No retry, reseed, or parameter change after seeing results.
calibration_rules.runtime: 110s internal monotonic deadline; SIGTERM or exception persists RUNTIME_OR_EXECUTION_FAILURE with partial tallies; no rerun.

config.event_counts: On an active cell-day, 2 + Bernoulli(0.5) events; counts are independent of outcomes.

family_choice.justification: momentum_rvol_1_5, momentum_1h_ema20_context and momentum_4h_ema20_context are filtered subsets of three_close_momentum, so testing the base arm covers the shared signal without multiplying near-duplicate hypotheses; the remaining arms are different signal definitions and stay in the 132 exploratory family. Choice made from the protocol text only, with no outcome data.
family_choice.relation_to_132: Strict subset. The 132 family and its Holm plan are unchanged; v2 is a separate narrowed candidate and does not retroactively relabel any inspected data.
family_choice.rule: Structural, performance-blind: the single base arm three_close_momentum crossed with every frozen timeframe x group x side (1 x 2 x 3 x 2 = 12 of the 132 frozen hypotheses).

scope: Synthetic calibration of a narrowed 12-hypothesis day-block sign-flip max-T candidate. No market data, no efficacy claim, no change to walkforward-protocol.json or the v1 artifacts.

statistic.blocks: Seven fixed non-overlapping contiguous 4-day blocks (28 = 7 x 4). The frozen walk-forward plan names 5-day blocks for resampling; 4 is used here only so blocks tile the 28-day fold exactly and exact enumeration is possible. This is a declared difference.
statistic.cell_statistic: B[b][h] = sum of S over block b. T_h = sum_b B[b][h] / sqrt(sum_b B[b][h]^2), a self-normalised block-sum statistic for H0: block sums symmetric about 0 (theta <= 0).
statistic.daily_panel: 28 UTC calendar rows x 12 columns of event-outcome sums S and event counts C; empty days remain.
statistic.eligibility: Every hypothesis needs >= 30 events, >= 10 nonempty days and positive sum of squared block sums; otherwise the whole panel is refused (counted as no rejection, reported separately).
statistic.multiplicity: Single-step max-T: adjusted p_h = #{sign vectors with max_j T*_j >= T_h} / 128. Reject h if adjusted p_h <= .05 (at most 6 of 128 vectors).
statistic.reference_distribution: Exact enumeration of all 2^7 = 128 block sign vectors, one vector shared by all 12 hypotheses; no Monte Carlo resampling error.

synthetic_cases.iid_heteroskedastic: Gaussian noise (loadings common/group/noise 0/0/1) with lognormal day volatility.
synthetic_cases.long_memory_serial: Common AR(1) rho .90 and group AR(1) rho .80, loadings .70/.50/.50: dependence extending across block boundaries.
synthetic_cases.power_three_of_twelve: iid_heteroskedastic noise plus +0.5 per-event mean on cells [0, 4, 8] (one false null in 3 of 12 hypotheses; noise sd about 1).
synthetic_cases.serial_heteroskedastic: AR(1) common rho .65 and group AR(1) rho .45, loadings .55/.35/.75.
synthetic_cases.skewed_mean_zero: Per-event noise Exp(1)-1 (mean 0, skewed) with day volatility plus common gaussian loading .5.
synthetic_cases.sparse_days: 72% active days, 90% active cells per day, iid noise; no forced empty cell.
